description: Come relax on a clear night at a mossy jungle temple overhang by a waterfall, with calm Minecraft music and a little red-eyed tree frog that hops by and croaks now and then. 10 hours of 4K, calming ambience with smooth music. Never interrupting with ads.
blurb: I put videos like these on the TV while I work from home, so I started making my own. Each video is one scene I designed for this channel. Excited to continue to develop more.

All my animation is made by myself and rendered frame by frame, and the ambience (wind, the frog's call, fish splashing and every other effect) is synthesized in my engine. I love making these videos, so please let me know what you would like to see next.
No stock footage, recordings or sound-effect libraries.
